title: Junior / Senior Graphic Designer + Motion Graphics Designer
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create high\-quality social media posts and marketing creatives.
* Design engaging reels, motion graphics, and animations,
* Develop creative concepts and visual styles based on campaign requirements and brand guidelines.
* Create animations, transitions, kinetic typography, visual effects, and logo animations.
* Maintain consistent brand identity across static and motion content.
* Collaborate with the marketing, content, and creative teams to develop campaign visuals.
* Convert creative concepts and briefs into professional, engaging designs.
* Manage multiple projects and deliver high\-quality work within deadlines.
* Stay updated with current graphic design, motion graphics, AI, social media, and visual content trends.



**Required Skills** 



* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, branding, and visual hierarchy.
* Good knowledge of motion graphics, animation, video editing, and visual effects.
* Creative thinking and strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a creative team.
